claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tripoli (Br), Harrison, Liverpool Sept 12, via
Queenstown 13th, with mdse and 499[?] passengers, to E Cu
nard. Sept 14, lat 51 18, lon 10 40, passed steamship Persia,
hence for Liverpool; 20th, lat 49 22, lon 35 52[?], bark Godolphe,
bound E, and bark Anastasia, bound W; 25th, lat 43 35, lon
59 10, steamship Hermann, hence for Bremen.
